name: zarvan-calendar
description: A Jalali (Persian) calendar UI for the web — month, week, day, year and list views, recurring events, filtering and Excel export. Right-to-left and Persian by design. No build step, no framework, no runtime dependencies.
author: ILIA
//delivery: Zarvan is loaded with a <script> tag and lives on window.Zarvan. There is deliberately no `main`, `exports` or `module`: it is not an ES module or a CommonJS module, and declaring that it is would only produce a confusing runtime failure. Copy dist/ into your static assets. See README.md.
//dependencies: There are none. jalaali.js is vendored in src/libs/ and built into dist/zarvan.js. SheetJS is optional and only used by the excel-export plugin, which resolves it at click time from options.deps.xlsx or window.XLSX.
//scripts: The build is plain concatenation. build.ps1 and build.sh are equivalent and need no toolchain at all; the node entry exists only for people who already have it. All three produce byte-identical output.

scripts.test: echo "Open test/index.html and test/host-hostile.html in a browser. Both print their own PASS/FAIL verdict." && exit 0
